{{Infobox | title = Template Improvement Recommendations | description = Actionable recommendations for addressing CRITICAL-003 template system gaps | type = schema-matter | author = BITCORE - Template Validation Engineer (TEMP-001) | created = 2026-02-13 | version = 1.0.0 | epistemic_status = Attribution-Traced | confidence = Established | license = CC-BY-SA-4.0 | ontology = entity_type: recommendation-document domain: template-system | workflow = state: Draft }} = Template Improvement Recommendations = '''Document ID:''' TEMP-001-REC-20260213 '''Date:''' 2026-02-13 '''Status:''' Draft for Review '''Constraint:''' Prototype only - no production changes without approval ---- == Executive Summary == This document provides concrete, actionable recommendations for addressing the 8 user concerns identified in CRITICAL-003. Each recommendation includes: * Problem statement * Proposed solution * Implementation steps * Risk assessment * Testing approach '''Priority Levels:''' * '''P0-Critical:''' Must fix immediately - blocks reliable template operation * '''P1-High:''' Should fix soon - significantly impacts template quality * '''P2-Medium:''' Fix when possible - improves maintainability * '''P3-Low:''' Nice to have - future enhancement ---- == Recommendation 1: Implement Lua-Based Validation (P0) == === Problem === Current templates use nested `#if` parser functions for validation, which: * Don't actually halt execution on validation failure * Allow `#set` to execute with empty/default values * Create false sense of security with error messages === Solution === Create centralized Lua validation modules that: * Strictly validate all required fields before any SMW operations * Return error HTML that blocks template rendering * Centralize controlled vocabulary definitions * Provide consistent error messaging === Implementation === '''Step 1: Create Module:ValidatorBase''' ```lua local p = {} -- Controlled vocabularies local VOCABS = { epistemic_status = {["Hypothetical"]=true, ["Provisional"]=true, ["Established"]=true, ["Deprecated"]=true}, stability_class = {["Volatile"]=true, ["Evolving"]=true, ["Stable"]=true, ["Canonical"]=true}, concept_type = {["Theory"]=true, ["Model"]=true, ["Framework"]=true, ["Principle"]=true, ["Pattern"]=true} } function p.validate_required(args, fields) local missing = {} for _, f in ipairs(fields) do if not args[f] or args[f]:match("^%s*$") then table.insert(missing, f) end end return #missing == 0, missing end function p.validate_vocab(value, vocab_name) if not value or value == "" then return true end local vocab = VOCABS[vocab_name] if not vocab then return false, "Unknown vocab: " .. vocab_name end if vocab[value] then return true end local valid = {} for k, _ in pairs(vocab) do table.insert(valid, k) end return false, "Invalid '" .. value .. "'. Valid: " .. table.concat(valid, ", ") end function p.render_error(errors) local html = '
' html = html .. "Template Error:
    " for _, e in ipairs(errors) do html = html .. "
  • " .. e .. "
    • " end return html .. "
" end return p ``` '''Step 2: Update Template''' ```mediawiki {{#invoke:InfoboxValidator|concept |title={{{title|}}} |definition={{{definition|}}} |domain={{{domain|}}} }} ``` === Risk Assessment === * '''Risk:''' Low - Lua modules are well-established in MediaWiki * '''Mitigation:''' Test thoroughly in staging environment * '''Rollback:''' Revert to previous template version === Testing === * [ ] Test with all required fields * [ ] Test with each required field missing * [ ] Test with invalid vocab values * [ ] Verify no SMW properties set on validation failure ---- == Recommendation 2: Fix #set Execution Guard (P0) == === Problem === `#set` parser function executes even when validation fails, creating invalid SMW data. === Solution === Move all `#set` calls inside Lua validation success block only. === Implementation === '''Before (Current):''' ```mediawiki {{#if: {{{Title|}}} | {{#if: {{{Definition|}}} | {{#set: Has title = {{{Title|}}} }} | {{Error|Missing Definition}} }} | {{Error|Missing Title}} }} ``` '''After (Fixed):''' ```lua -- In Module:InfoboxValidator function p.concept(frame) local args = frame.args local base = require("Module:ValidatorBase") -- Validate FIRST local valid, missing = base.validate_required(args, {"title", "definition", "domain"}) if not valid then return base.render_error(missing) end -- Only NOW generate SMW local smw = "{{#set:" smw = smw .. "|Has title=" .. args.title smw = smw .. "|Has definition=" .. args.definition smw = smw .. "|Has domain=" .. args.domain smw = smw .. "}}" return smw .. render_infobox_html(args) end ``` === Risk Assessment === * '''Risk:''' Medium - changes SMW data generation timing * '''Mitigation:''' Test with existing pages to ensure properties still set * '''Rollback:''' Immediate revert if SMW queries break ---- == Recommendation 3: Enforce Controlled Vocabularies (P1) == === Problem === Controlled vocabularies documented in TemplateData but not enforced in template code. === Solution === Centralize vocabularies in Lua module and validate all inputs. === Implementation === '''Step 1: Define Vocabularies''' ```lua -- In Module:ValidatorBase local CONTROLLED_VOCABS = { epistemic_status = { values = {["Hypothetical"]=1, ["Provisional"]=2, ["Established"]=3, ["Deprecated"]=4}, default = "Provisional" }, concept_type = { values = {["Theory"]=true, ["Model"]=true, ["Framework"]=true, ["Principle"]=true, ["Pattern"]=true}, default = nil } } function p.get_vocab(name) return CONTROLLED_VOCABS[name] end ``` '''Step 2: Validate in Template''' ```lua function p.validate_concept_type(value) local vocab = CONTROLLED_VOCABS.concept_type if not value then return true, nil end -- optional if vocab.values[value] then return true, value end return false, "Invalid concept_type. Valid: " .. table.concat(vocab.values, ", ") end ``` '''Step 3: Add SMW Constraints''' ```smw [[Has concept type::]] [[Allows value::Theory]] [[Allows value::Model]] [[Allows value::Framework]] [[Allows value::Principle]] [[Allows value::Pattern]] ``` === Risk Assessment === * '''Risk:''' Low - prevents bad data entry * '''Mitigation:''' Allow migration period for existing pages * '''Rollback:''' Remove SMW constraints if needed ---- == Recommendation 4: Implement Relationship Field Specification (P1) == === Problem === Relationship fields use comma-separated values without type pairing, creating ambiguity. === Solution === Use structured format: `PageName[relationship_type]` === Implementation === '''New Format:''' ```mediawiki {{Infobox_Concept | title = Machine Learning | definition = ... | domain = CS | related_concepts = Neural Networks[part-of], Deep Learning[extends], Statistics[depends-on] }} ``` '''Lua Parser:''' ```lua function p.parse_relationships(rel_string) local rels = {} for entry in rel_string:gmatch("([^,]+)") do entry = entry:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") local page, rel_type = entry:match("^(.-)%s*%[(.-)%]$") if page then table.insert(rels, {page=page, type=rel_type}) else table.insert(rels, {page=entry, type="related-to"}) -- default end end return rels end ``` '''SMW Generation:''' ```lua for _, rel in ipairs(rels) do smw = smw .. "[[Has relationship to::" .. rel.page .. "]]" smw = smw .. "[[Has relationship type::" .. rel.type .. "]]" end ``` === Risk Assessment === * '''Risk:''' Medium - changes parameter format * '''Mitigation:''' Support both old and new formats during transition * '''Migration:''' Bot to update existing pages ---- == Recommendation 5: Create CSS Theme System (P1) == === Problem === Inline styles throughout templates make theming difficult and create fragility. === Solution === Move all styling to MediaWiki:Common.css with semantic class names. === Implementation === '''Step 1: Create CSS Classes''' ```css /* MediaWiki:Common.css */ /* Infobox base */ .bitwiki-infobox { border: 1px solid var(--border-color, #ccc); border-radius: 4px; margin: 0.5em 0; } .bitwiki-infobox-header { background: var(--header-bg, #f5f5f5); padding: 0.5em 1em; font-weight: bold; } /* Epistemic badges */ .bitwiki-epistemic-badge { display: inline-block; padding: 0.2em 0.5em; border-radius: 3px; font-size: 0.85em; } .bitwiki-epistemic-established { background: #d4edda; color: #155724; } .bitwiki-epistemic-provisional { background: #fff3cd; color: #856404; } .bitwiki-epistemic-hypothetical { background: #f8d7da; color: #721c24; } .bitwiki-epistemic-deprecated { background: #e2e3e5; color: #383d41; } /* Validation errors */ .bitwiki-validation-error { background: #f8d7da; border: 1px solid #f5c6cb; border-radius: 4px; padding: 10px 15px; margin: 10px 0; color: #721c24; } /* Responsive */ @media (max-width: 768px) { .bitwiki-infobox { width: 100%; } } ``` '''Step 2: Update Templates''' ```mediawiki Established Established ``` === Risk Assessment === * '''Risk:''' Low - CSS changes are reversible * '''Mitigation:''' Test on multiple browsers * '''Rollback:''' Revert CSS file ---- == Recommendation 6: Simplify Template_EvidenceEpistemics (P2) == === Problem === Template is overly complex with nested template calls and no validation. === Solution === Refactor into composable components with Lua-based validation. === Implementation === '''Break into Components:''' # `Template:EvidenceHeader` - Document metadata # `Template:EvidenceClaim` - Claim with validation # `Template:EvidenceSource` - Source evaluation # `Template:EvidenceNavigation` - Related frameworks '''New Structure:''' ```mediawiki {{#invoke:EvidenceValidator|main |title={{{title|}}} |primary_claim={{{primary_claim|}}} |epistemic_tier={{{epistemic_tier|}}} |sources={{{sources|}}} }} ``` === Risk Assessment === * '''Risk:''' Medium - changes template interface * '''Mitigation:''' Create new version, deprecate old * '''Migration:''' Update pages gradually ---- == Recommendation 7: Implement Template Drift Detection (P2) == === Problem === Four infobox templates share 85% code but can drift out of sync. === Solution === Create base module and automated drift detection. === Implementation === '''Step 1: Create Module:InfoboxBase''' ```lua local p = {} function p.render_infobox(args, config) -- Shared infobox rendering logic -- config specifies template-specific fields end function p.validate_infobox(args, config) -- Shared validation logic -- config specifies required fields and vocabularies end return p ``` '''Step 2: Drift Detection Script''' ```python # compare_templates.py import re def extract_validation_pattern(template_text): # Extract validation logic pass def compare_templates(template1, template2): # Compare patterns and report differences pass ``` === Risk Assessment === * '''Risk:''' Low - detection is non-invasive * '''Mitigation:''' Run in CI/CD pipeline * '''Rollback:''' Disable detection if noisy ---- == Recommendation 8: Add Comprehensive Testing (P1) == === Problem === No automated testing for template validation. === Solution === Create test suite for all validation scenarios. === Implementation === '''Test Cases:''' ```yaml test_cases: - name: "Valid concept" template: "Infobox_Concept" params: title: "Test Concept" definition: "A test concept" domain: "CS" expected: "pass" - name: "Missing required" template: "Infobox_Concept" params: title: "Test" # definition missing domain: "CS" expected: "fail" error_contains: "definition" - name: "Invalid vocab" template: "Infobox_Concept" params: title: "Test" definition: "A test" domain: "CS" concept_type: "InvalidType" expected: "fail" error_contains: "concept_type" ``` === Risk Assessment === * '''Risk:''' Very low - testing doesn't affect production * '''Mitigation:''' Run tests before any deployment ---- == Implementation Roadmap == === Phase 1: Foundation (Week 1-2) === * [ ] Create Module:ValidatorBase * [ ] Create Module:InfoboxValidator * [ ] Create CSS theme system * [ ] Set up test framework === Phase 2: Core Templates (Week 3-4) === * [ ] Migrate Infobox_Concept * [ ] Migrate Infobox_Idea * [ ] Migrate Infobox_Implementation * [ ] Migrate Infobox_Project === Phase 3: Secondary Templates (Week 5-6) === * [ ] Migrate Template_Comment * [ ] Refactor Template_EpistemicTier * [ ] Refactor Template_EvidenceEpistemics === Phase 4: Enhancement (Week 7-8) === * [ ] Implement drift detection * [ ] Add relationship validation * [ ] Complete test coverage ---- == Approval Required == Before implementing any changes: # '''Review this document''' - Ensure recommendations align with goals # '''Approve prototypes''' - Review prototype templates in `/prototypes/` # '''Schedule maintenance window''' - Plan for template updates # '''Define rollback plan''' - Ensure quick revert if issues arise '''Do NOT implement without explicit approval.''' ---- ''Document generated by Template Validation Engineer (TEMP-001)'' ''Epistemic status: Attribution-Traced | Confidence: Established''
